m9d_result.checkpoint_observation: 0.75-1.0 ATR checkpoints had the strongest exploratory average checkpoint-to-exit metrics, but checkpoint depth is not promoted as an entry or stop rule.
m9d_result.mae_observation: Winner/loser adverse excursion separation is large in XAU/BTC and LONG/SHORT; depth alone remains insufficient because many trades recover after meaningful adverse movement.
m9d_result.interpretation: Study causal state and structural reversal evidence during the adverse path.
